All three declared checkers (object-creation-and-design, picklist-and-value-sets --min-severity ERROR, platform-events-apex) exited 0 verbatim from the build directory. check-outputs ok (17/17 declared outputs present, non-empty, well-formed). confidence_rationale: Every declared test ran (three checkers) or was correctly classified as manual (one); both always-on checks completed with zero exclusions requiring judgment beyond the step's own documented inline-fields note; every result came from an exit code this agent observed directly (raw captures under tests/M1-S01/raw/). No command test was refused, no coverage-gap exclusion had to be applied, and check-outputs reported ok with no missing/empty/malformed outputs.

process_observations.observation: All three declared checkers exited 0 on the very first verbatim run with no repair loop, and the manifest and xml checks were consistent on the first pass, matching the build envelope's own claim of a clean first-pass build.

The step's own deploy-order.md documents in advance that Tier2_Escalation__e's five payload fields are inline in the object file and are not separate CustomField members, so the manifest exclusion this agent applied was a documented design choice rather than an ambiguity resolved at test time.

AGENT.md cites skills/devops/metadata-api-coverage-gaps as the source of which metadata types have no standalone source file for the manifest-exclusion rule, but that skill's content is about deploy-mechanism support gaps (Metadata API vs source tracking vs packages) and names no such file-shape exclusion list; the exclusion this run applied came instead from the step's own deploy-order.md.

evidence.query: grep for platform event / inline / no standalone file across SKILL.md and references/*.md returned nothing on point

process_observations.observation: deploy-order.md section 6 records that Status__c is a required field and cannot carry a fieldPermissions entry in M1-S02's permission set (required-field permissions cannot be retrieved or deployed at API 30.0+); the operator has already amended M1-S02's inputs to exclude it. This step's own artefacts and tests are unaffected - noted here only because it was named in this run's brief and is exactly the kind of cross-step finding step-tester does not adjudicate.

This build's plan.json carries scale: feature, and neither agents/step-tester/AGENT.md nor standards/build-orchestration.md section 3.1's Agent deltas table names any branch for step-tester at any scale ('no branch. A step is a step at every scale, and that is the point.') - so there was no scale-specific instruction to look for and none was missed, but it is worth recording that the AGENT.md and the CLI (build_plan.py set-status) both ran identically regardless of the plan's scale, exactly as section 3.1 documents for this agent.
